HTTPS 证书管理

所有服务共用一张证书，包含本机网卡 IPv4，服务证书默认 20 年、CA 30 年。启动时检查，运行中每分钟检查，剩余不足 30 天或新增网卡 IP 时自动补签。新连接使用新证书，现有 MCP 连接不重启。无需公网或额外进程。

客户端必须信任公开 CA，不会跳过验证。Windows 导入公开 .cer 到当前用户的受信任根证书库。Node/独立证书库使用公开 .pem，配置 NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS。

HTTPS certificate management

All services share one certificate covering local IPv4 adapters. Service certificates default to 20 years and the CA to 30 years. Checked at startup and every minute; renewed when less than 30 days remain or adapter IPs change. New connections use the new certificate without restarting existing MCP connections. No public network or extra process is required.

Clients must trust the public CA; verification is never bypassed. Import .cer into the Windows current-user trusted root store. For Node / separate stores, use .pem with NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.
